description.p: You are given an array colors whose elements represent one of three colors: red (0), green (1) and blue (2). Sort the array so that the colors go in the order: red, green, blue, and return the modified array.
It is important that the sorting is done in-place, which means sorting without using additional memory for copies of the array.

ul: Time: O(n), where n is the length of the array colors
